title: Gate C host and pinned native CCP2 tests
description:
Scope: CCP2 C/Zephyr jobs in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/.github/workflows/interop.yml, reusing /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/.github/workflows/ec2-arm64.yml native-test conventions where appropriate. Run real production consumers and completed L2/HAL integration suites under /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/lichen/tests/. Distinguish host CTest from the repository-pinned Zephyr native_sim runtime, with sanitizer and header/implementation/stub coverage. Use local Linux tooling first. No hardware ports, RF emissions or new cloud infrastructure are authorized by this leaf.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reuse existing CMake/Twister and Linux-builder paths; add only focused CCP2 job wiring. Depend on zephyr.14 and vectors.14, not the language parent, and preserve separate evidence classes.
acceptance_criteria: Host ASan/UBSan suites and required pinned native_sim tests report nonzero executed cases against the frozen independent corpus. Missing suites, filtered-all Twister runs, stale binaries, header/stub mismatch and runtime failures fail the required job. Record Zephyr/SDK/compiler/target versions and exact commands. A compile or a different Zephyr-version smoke test cannot substitute for the required native runtime evidence.
